response.overview: The people of Huamachuco bring the Passion of Christ to life in a grand, folk-style tableau. The streets are packed with a fervent crowd—cameras in hand, whips at the ready—while the skin of Jesus bears the vivid, pulsing mark of blood. The bullring is transformed into a Roman Colosseum, and police officers appear in a hybrid attire of Roman soldier costumes and their own official uniforms. Everything speaks to the subtle boundary between reality and fiction, between a festive ritual and its unmistakable enactment. Filming this moment was a way to explore the joy we derive from great stories—especially those that end in tragedy...
response.title: Pasión Huamachuco
